title: CR-BRK-004 — Parts Dept OFF but child CRUD set — parent-gate bypass
preconds: Parts Dept \u2717 | Catalog & Inv V/E/D \u2713 | Part Sales V/E \u2713 | Vendor & Order V/E \u2713 | WO V \u2713 | See Financial \u2713 | View Mode: Full (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.

expected:
